title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the month of May 1985 as "Better Hearing and Speech Month". (Public Law 99-48)
summary: S.J.Res. 93 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-48 on 1985-06-12.

summary: S.J.Res. 87 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-57 on 1985-06-27.

title: New law: A joint resolution designating June 14, 1985, as "Baltic Freedom Day". (Public Law 99-49)
